_comment: Guided tour for Settings > Plots (emtk app). 'name' is the control: a field's attr, a button's action, '<section>.fold' for a section header, 'preview_plot' for the preview. Steps with an 'await' wait for the user to use the control.

steps.title: A fit window, on sample data
steps.text: The preview is laid out like a fit window: the autocorrelation of the residuals on top, the weighted residuals under it, the decay below. It is a simulated measurement -- an instrument response convolved with two lifetimes, background and photon noise -- with a fit that is close but not exact, so data, model and residuals can be told apart. Every control on the left acts on it at once.

steps.title: Pick a colour and watch the preview
steps.text: Click the swatch beside Model for a colour picker, or type a hex value such as #22cc44 and press Enter. The model curve in the preview changes at once.

steps.title: Changes apply at once and are kept
steps.text: There is no Apply button: a change is in force as soon as you make it and is saved for the next start, as in Settings ▸ Fonts. Every fit already on screen is restyled at once. The line under the controls says what happened.

steps.title: The fit range
steps.text: The band marks the channels the fit uses; you drag its edges in a fit window. Turn its Opacity up or down here -- much above 60 it hides the data under it.

steps.title: Global fits
steps.text: With several datasets in one global fit, the selected one is drawn solid and the others dimmed. Other fits sets how dim: the second dataset in the preview follows it.

steps.title: Axes and grid
steps.text: Axis names, the legend, the size of the axis text and how strongly the grid is drawn, per panel. Axis text 'auto' follows the interface font of Settings ▸ Fonts.

steps.title: Back to the shipped look
steps.text: Reset to defaults puts every plot setting back, applied at once and saved.
